title: Goal Retrieval versus Action-Value Ordering: Contrastive Critics under Best-of-$K$ Selection
abstract: arXiv:2607.27422v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Goal-conditioned action generators can produce many plausible actions. Best-of-\(K\) selection then uses a critic to rank those actions for the current state and goal. Standard contrastive critics are trained and evaluated on a different ranking: distinguishing future goals from unrelated negatives for a fixed state--action pair. The unnormalized contrastive score is monotone in behavior-policy value at the population optimum. Cosine-normalized scores lack this guarantee, and finite trained networks may fail to recover the correct ordering. We audit the resulting gap using shared state--goal queries and frozen candidate pools, so critics differ only in their action ordering. Raw and cosine critics reach retrieval AUCs of \(0.96\)--\(1.00\) across eight OGBench tasks. Their progress ordering on navigation tasks is much weaker and sometimes inverted. translated_title: 目标检索与动作价值排序：Best-of-K 选择下的对比式评论家
translated_abstract: 目标条件动作生成器能够产生许多看似合理的动作，Best-of-K 选择随后利用评论家针对当前状态和目标对这些动作进行排序。然而，标准的对比式评论家是在一种不同的排序任务上训练和评估的：针对固定的状态-动作对，将未来目标与无关负样本区分开来。本文证明，在总体最优处，未归一化的对比得分关于行为策略价值是单调的；而余弦归一化得分缺乏这一保证，且经有限训练的网络可能无法恢复正确的排序。作者使用共享的状态-目标查询和冻结的候选池来审计由此产生的差距，从而确保各评论家仅在动作排序上存在差异。在八个 OGBench 任务上，原始得分与余弦归一化评论家的检索 AUC 达到 0.96–1.00，但它们在导航任务上对动作进展的排序能力要弱得多，有时甚至出现颠倒。在精确价值受控的问题中，所有三个对比选择器都具有更高的平均……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了对比式评论家“擅长目标检索却不擅长动作价值排序”的差距：未归一化对比得分在总体最优处对行为策略价值单调，但余弦归一化及有限训练的网络在 Best-of-K 选择中可能给出错误的动作排序。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes a gap in which contrastive critics excel at goal retrieval yet can misorder actions under Best-of-K selection: unnormalized contrastive scores are monotone in behavior-policy value at the population optimum, whereas cosine normalization and finitely trained networks may fail to recover the correct action ordering.
